description:
A belief created at 0.44 and then corroborated five times, reaching 0.87 and staying TENTATIVE.

The confidence is NOT authored past its creation value: the trajectory is whatever `blend_confidence` produces through the priced ingest path, and pre-registration section 0.1 derived it by hand before any detector existed (0.6516, 0.7609, 0.8193, 0.8516, 0.8700).

Agent-reachable and never naturally occurring: `core.update_beliefs` validates caller-supplied candidates with no clamp and no floor (core.py:322-326), while 0 of 640 stored beliefs sit below 0.45 and the reflection path is floored at 0.45 by construction (services.py:1001). This is the agent half of the registered split, and it is an example rather than the headline for exactly that reason.

expect.note: Structural properties, checkable by reading the file. No expected detector output appears anywhere in this fixture; requirements section 7. The confidence reached is not authored; only the creation value and the corroboration count are.
